name: Shirase Hayato
source:
Manager of Shirase Sky Sports. A very pleasant young man that runs an FC specialized shop in the shoping district. A former Flying Circus player, he knows Aoi very well.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
